timeline.message:
Clean up DeflateCompressor after exception

We must reset the thread-local buffer in `DeflateCompressor` whether the
compression succeeds or fails.

Closes #87160
timeline.author: David Turner

timeline.body: Hi @DaveCTurner, I've created a changelog YAML for you.
Should this fail if exception was not thrown?

reply.body: No, there's no checksum or anything so modifying a byte will sometimes yield a valid (but different) output.
